# Alchemists Network

> Alchemists Network is a free, global community that connects people with trusted expertise, masterclasses, live sessions and meaningful conversations across four areas of life: Finance, Health, Relationships and Spirituality. Members join a topic group on WhatsApp. Its tagline is "Every life transformed starts with one expert who dared to share."

Alchemists Network was founded by Andrew A. Porteous, a financial educator and personal development coach, as a platform for speakers, healers, educators and alchemists to inspire, provide value and transform lives. It is operated by A&M Business Communication UG (haftungsbeschränkt), Rheurdt, Germany. Joining is free and open to adults (18+). Contact: rise@alchemistsnetwork.com.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://www.alchemistsnetwork.com/): what the community offers, the four interest areas and how to join free in three steps (choose, join, connect and grow)
- [International Women's Leadership Summit](https://www.alchemistsnetwork.com/womenssummit): free one-day online summit, live on Zoom, Friday 4 December 2026, 8:45 to 17:00 CET; speakers, programme, workshops and registration (live only, no replay)

## Communities

- [Finance](https://www.alchemistsnetwork.com/#interests): a healthier relationship with money, smarter financial decisions and principles for long-term wealth
- [Health](https://www.alchemistsnetwork.com/#interests): practical ideas and habits for a healthier body, more energy and sustainable wellbeing
- [Relationships](https://www.alchemistsnetwork.com/#interests): deeper connections, better communication and relationships that enrich your life
- [Spirituality](https://www.alchemistsnetwork.com/#interests): practices and conversations for awareness, inner peace, meaning and connection
